page.layout: One page of text in a single column; a marginal note in the right margin beside "Non etiam temporariam significat"; italic references set between lines of the column; running head at top; catchword "Sed" at the foot right.

main_text.p: cordia, Christi JEsu satisfactio & intercessio. Obnoxiorum resipiscentia & fides.

Deinde negant, Christum perpetuam mortem subiisse. Respondetur: Etiamsi Christus ad tempus tantum cruciatus damnatorum passus sit: quippe execratio pro nobis factus est,Galat.3.13 adeo, ut se derelictum putaret a DEo.Psalm. 22. 1. Matth 27. 46. Heb. 5. 7. Actor. 2. 24. tamen istud aequipollet morti aeternae, propter dignitatem personae, quae est Deus aeternus.
Non etiam temporariam significat[?] Mortem, inquiunt: Quia significaret aut violentam aut naturalem.

At neque violentam. Quia nemo est, qui jure propter aliena peccata occidatur: At jure occidi potest, si sponte alienum debitum in se exsolvendum recepit. Deinde, inquiunt, quia innumerabiles reperiuntur, qui quamvis nec propter sua, nec propter aliena peccata, tamen interficiuntur, ut sunt Martyres Dei & Christi.

page.notes: The "303" at the top right corner is a handwritten number, not printed, and is left out. The marginal note beside "significat" is in small italic type that I could not read with confidence; the words appear to be "Altera sent." and "sumi part." (or similar), so I have marked it as doubtful. The references "Galat.3.13" and "Psalm. 22. 1..." are set between text lines and read as marginal references. The "Sed" at the foot is the catchword.
